look: XORA site look, same as the V00 welcome film: deep void ground, frosted glass panels with thin cyan-to-violet edges, fictional market lines drawing in, calm eased motion, the brain tutor guiding from the bottom-right corner

scenes.name: Lesson sixteen
scenes.desc: Title card: Phase 4, lesson T16, Trend and Market Structure; a zig-zag path climbs with HH and HL marks; the tutor walks in.

scenes.name: Up, down or nowhere?
scenes.desc: A fictional BTC chart zig-zags; one candle cannot say where price is going; the peaks and dips light up: market structure.

scenes.name: Peaks and dips
scenes.desc: Swing high (peak) and swing low (dip) defined; hilly road analogy; a peak is only clear after price turns away.

scenes.name: Uptrend
scenes.desc: Higher highs 60,100, 60,200, 60,300 and higher lows 59,980, 60,080, 60,180 write onto the chart like a staircase; HH and HL labels.

scenes.name: Downtrend
scenes.desc: Lower highs 60,320, 60,220, 60,120 and lower lows 60,200, 60,100, 60,000; LH and LL labels.

scenes.name: Sideways
scenes.desc: Peaks near 60,200 and dips near 60,000 inside a shaded band: a range, no clear direction.

scenes.name: Structure changes
scenes.desc: One path writes: higher highs and lows, a stalled peak (sideways), then a lower high and a lower low; labels appear only after each turn.

scenes.name: Check with numbers
scenes.desc: Worked example: 60,240 - 60,290 = -50 (lower high); 60,060 - 60,150 = -90 (lower low); the uptrend pattern is broken.

scenes.name: One candle is not a trend
scenes.desc: Common mistake: a big green candle inside lower highs and lower lows; trend comes from swings, on a stated timeframe.

scenes.name: Try it
scenes.desc: Pause and classify three fictional charts: A downtrend, B sideways, C uptrend.

scenes.name: A judgement call
scenes.desc: Two markings of the same chart; tiny wiggles ignored; a different timeframe can show a different trend.

scenes.name: Know the limits
scenes.desc: Trends end without warning, buying late can mean buying near the top, structure is not a signal; WAIT and NO_TRADE are always allowed.

scenes.name: Recap
scenes.desc: Three key points and one question: peaks 60,300 then 60,240, dips 60,150 then 60,060 is a downtrend so far.

scenes.name: Up next
scenes.desc: End card: next lesson T17, Support, Resistance, Breakout, Fakeout.
